scope: Read-only targeted review of three previously accepted hotels. No prices, provider requests, messages, publication, repository, Site or hold mutations.
method: Saved cards plus current system1 searches with recency and opened primary hotel/owner pages and original operator notices. Elapsed dates and removed notices were not treated as completion evidence.

hotels.name: Waldorf Astoria Dubai Palm Jumeirah
hotels.conclusion: Sufficient for a limited accurate post with a caveat; update the former unconditional Pearl Club closure statement.
supported_available: Coral Travel's dated hotel operations update of 2026-10-02 explicitly reports Pearl Club service periods, an open beach until sunset, and operating pools, spa and kids club.
Current Hilton Pearl Club page describes service periods and availability, consistent with resumed club service, though closing hours differ from the operator notice.
supported_restrictions: The dated October operator update says check-in/check-out service is not available inside Pearl Club until further notice.
Best at Travel currently carries a nearby construction warning with possible audible/visible works.
unresolved_but_avoidable: No completion certificate for August 3-7 beach nourishment was found. An explicit October operating update supports current beach availability without claiming every work finished.

KOMPAS still carries the old full Pearl closure notice; the later dated October operator update is materially newer and affirmative. Preserve conflict in research evidence instead of copying the old claim into a current post.
Exact Pearl closing hours and shuttle availability conflict across pages; omit these details from the short post.
hotels.suggested_caveat: Рядом с отелем идут строительные работы, возможен шум. Регистрацию заезда и выезда в Pearl Club пока не проводят; клубные привилегии зависят от категории номера.

hotels.name: Rixos Al Mairid Ras Al Khaimah
hotels.conclusion: Sufficient for a limited post acknowledging renovations. The beach reopening evidence is specific to this hotel and describes an accomplished reopening, not a future plan.
supported_available: Planeta Travel explicitly reports that this hotel's beach and beach infrastructure reopened on 2026-11-08 and are being used by guests.
KOMPAS and Etihad Holidays report villa accommodation, six operating pools and continuing Rixy activities in a temporary first-floor right-wing space.
L'Olivo and Toro Loco are listed as available restaurant choices by the two operator descriptions.
supported_restrictions: Rooms in the main building are under renovation through the planned 2026-11-30 window; reopening/accommodation is scheduled for December, not verified as already completed.
The permanent Rixy Kids Club is being rebuilt; new club completion is planned for February 2027.
Orient is temporarily closed with December reopening planned.
unresolved_but_avoidable: Turquoise is reported available by Etihad Holidays but temporarily unavailable in KOMPAS's dining list. Do not promise this restaurant or that every restaurant operates.

Etihad Holidays still displays a general closure notice for Ras Al Khaimah hotel beaches. The hotel's specific subsequent opening notice from Planeta Travel is affirmative, dated by event and identifies the exact property.
The entire main building is not established as closed: the temporary kids club is in its right wing. Restriction wording must specify main-building rooms.
hotels.suggested_caveat: Номера главного корпуса обновляют, размещение сейчас предусмотрено в виллах. Family Pool и ресторан Orient временно недоступны, Rixy работает во временном помещении. Сроки открытия и доступные услуги уточняются на даты поездки.

hotels.name: InterContinental Nha Trang
hotels.conclusion: Sufficient for a limited post with the explicit ongoing-noise warning. Do not narrow the noise period to daytime without a source.
supported_available: Official hotel and IHG pages currently offer hotel accommodation and publish reception/check-in terms.
The hotel's facilities page publishes pool hours 06:00-18:00, gym 24/7, spa 11:00-20:00 and describes Planet Trekker kids club.
Official site lists current dining operations and events.
supported_restrictions: The official alert says noise continues from Residences renovation and nearby construction.
InterContinental Nha Trang and InterContinental Residences Nha Trang operate separately; hotel facilities are not available to Residences guests.
unresolved_but_avoidable: No completion date, work hours or definitive list of affected rooms is provided by the official alert.
No hotel-wide closure is reported in the alert; no claim of operational availability for specific travel dates was checked.
The alert does not say noise is limited to daytime. Do not imply quiet nights.
Pool counts conflict between IHG sections; use the generic plural rather than a count.
hotels.suggested_caveat: Отель предупреждает о шуме из-за ремонта Residences и стройки рядом; срок окончания работ не указан. InterContinental Nha Trang и Residences — разные объекты.

caution: All availability statements are attributed to public hotel/operator notices checked on 2026-11-13. They are not live checks of a booked package, future dates, room inventory or service delivery. No holds were removed.
